rationale: Revise 3c460936dd01f0d66e4e7dd2a9e661e8274df4fc: src/resourceEvidence.ts:353-359 must preserve blockers until complete same-resource clearance, but exact-pin probes show A+B exhausted followed by A exhausted with a later deadline and B below 100 with spendControlReached absent drops B, so a later A-clear/B-missing read falsely clears, while a new exhausted 60-minute window also overwrites a prior 300-minute blocker and later clears without proving that original restriction resolved; add both sequential regressions and fail closed on incomplete or changed identity evidence; src/runLoop.ts:1262-1267 must hold lifecycle exclusion through the cursor mutation because a Stop/session change after lifecycleAfter is read but before this.mutate leaves cached stale=false and can still release, so test a lifecycle event at the post-check/pre-mutation boundary rather than only during the helper read.
